ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_margin_rank_blend_tanh_advantage_diff_scaled_weighted
ir.intuition: Fixed novelty failure by changing the normalized max advantage weighting to weighting based on the absolute difference of advantages, which is less similar to prior max-based normalizations. Removed norm scaling of margin and replaced weighting by abs(advantage_w - advantage_l). This preserves pairwise advantage contrast for ranking while breaking similarity. Also avoid scaling margin by norm to reduce numerical complexity and maintain interpretability.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
weight = batch.get('weight', None)
ad_diff = abs(adv_w - adv_l)
margin = lpw - lpl
clamped_margin = clamp(margin, -10, 10)
smooth_margin = tanh(clamped_margin)
hinge = relu(1 - smooth_margin)
loss = hinge * ad_diff
if weight is not None:
  loss *= weight
final_loss = mean(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    adv_diff = ops.abs(ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l))
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(margin, -10.0, 10.0)
    smooth_margin = ops.tanh(clamped_margin)
    hinge = ops.relu(ops.sub(ops.ones_like(smooth_margin), smooth_margin))
    loss = ops.mul(hinge, adv_diff)
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
